profile.summary: Street Soccer USA is a national nonprofit that runs free, year-round soccer and youth development programs in under-resourced neighborhoods in cities across the United States. It partners with schools and community groups to run programs and build soccer parks and learning centers. Its programs combine soccer with social-emotional skill building and connections to education and employment resources.
